rows.label: obsidian
rows.hook: is a black, glassy stone that can be chipped into razor-sharp blades

rows.label: limestone
rows.description: sedimentary rocks made of the chemical substance calcium carbonate
rows.hook: is the stone that builds cave systems and holds countless fossils of ancient shells and corals

rows.label: coal
rows.description: combustible sedimentary rock composed primarily of carbon
rows.hook: is a black fuel dug from mines that powered the Industrial Revolution

rows.label: granite
rows.description: common type of intrusive, felsic, igneous rock with grained texture
rows.hook: is a hard, speckled stone used for kitchen countertops and gravestones

rows.label: marble
rows.description: foliated metamorphic rock of carbonatic minerals
rows.hook: is a veined stone that sculptors carve into statues and builders use for polished floors

rows.label: flint
rows.hook: is a hard stone that makes sparks when struck and was shaped into prehistoric tools

rows.label: pumice
rows.description: light coloured highly vesicular volcanic rock

rows.label: chalk
rows.hook: is a soft white stone that forms the cliffs of Dover and was long used to write on blackboards

rows.label: sandstone
rows.hook: is a grainy stone made of cemented sand, forming red desert arches and cliffs

rows.label: travertine
rows.description: form of terrestrial limestone deposited around mineral springs, especially hot springs
